segments.tha-ap524:1.3: Ekamañcaṃ [ekaṃ veccaṃ (syā.), ekapacchaṃ (pī.)] mayā dinnaṃ, pasannena sapāṇinā.
segments.tha-ap524:5.1: “Svāgataṃ vata me āsi … pe … kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ.
segments.tha-ap524:7.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā mañcadāyako [veccakadāyako (syā.), saddasaññikavaggepi idaṃ § apadānaṃ dissati] thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthāti.
